checks_run.procedure: Adversarial verification of the evidence SoD fix in the API and the DB. Probes: the round-1 note and file paths, owner-edit variants (note, URL, file), title-only laundering, controls, and a mth_app DB bypass with a matching audit event (author review, spoofed content_authored_by, uploader review, pre-reviewed INSERT, independent control). The probe runs in a disposable clone on disposable PG16, twice.

checks_run.expected: Foreign edit or upload gives 403. A review by the creator, content author or current uploader gives 403 evidence.reviewer_is_author with a denied audit. The DB trigger refuses with 23514 evidence_review_separation. Independent controls succeed.
checks_run.actual: Both runs: 140.note.tl_edit_other [403, audited, author stays WL]; 140.file.tl_upload_other [403, 0 revisions]; owner_note/url/file: edit 200, review 403 evidence.reviewer_is_author with 1 authorization.denied; launder_title 403; controls 200. db_bypass: note_author_reviews, note_author_spoofs_content_author, file_uploader_reviews and insert_prereviewed_by_creator all 23514:evidence_review_separation; control_independent_reviewer COMMITTED. The round-1 SEC-1 asserts now fail 400 instead of 403, a probe artefact: the foreign edit is refused first, so If-Match is "undefined" (see probes/README.md).

checks_run.procedure: Manual source review of the repair diff 98a8d99..eb8163e2 (41 non-doc files) for regressions in authorization, integrity and concurrency. Covered: evidence routes (EDIT_OWN/ARCHIVE rules, the review re-check after the lock, link removal with recordOwnership using kysely-quoted identifiers from a DB-constrained record_type); migration 0019 (trigger semantics; no backfill); kpi activate; trajectoryAuthors / outcomeKpiChangeEvents (diff keys equal the columns; all outcome_kpi UPDATE paths audited); gates.ts sequenceProblem on submit, decide and canSubmit; phase.ts exactly-one-step advance re-checked under the transformation FOR UPDATE lock (race-safe); charter North Star current-link rule; composeThesis; web pages (no innerHTML or dangerouslySetInnerHTML).

checks_run.expected: No new authz bypass, integrity gap, injection or concurrency defect introduced by the repairs
checks_run.actual: None found.
